finalText:
**Fixed it — the build now exits clean (0 warnings blocking, 0 errors).**

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `maxRetries: retries` referenced a variable named `retries` that never existed, instead of `env.retries`. Every build hit this and crashed at the link stage with `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`.

Changed it to `maxRetries: env.retries || 3`, matching the comment's intent (use the env value, fall back to a constant). Build now finishes in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors — the 3 remaining warnings are pre-existing (a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import) and didn't block anything, so I left them alone unless you want those cleaned up too.
